  block_girls_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
      "Block", 
      "Girls 2024" AS girls_2024
    FROM 
      "school_enrolment_by_year"
  ),

    SELECT 
      "Block",

FROM 
  block_girls_2024

  block_all_enrolled_2024
WHERE 
  "Block" IN ("Atri", "Barachatti", "Belaganj", "Dobhi")
